nodes.label: Blind Import (Admin)
nodes.rationale: Blind admin imports return only counts/conflicts/errors; titles, bodies, checklist text, image data, and filenames are never previewed to protect user privacy while still allowing operator remediation.

nodes.label: Owner-Scope Repository Save Finding
nodes.rationale: NoteRepository/NotebookRepository.save lacked explicit OwnerId scope, violating the repository-wide owner-scope rule; required an explicit scope argument and mismatch tests.

nodes.label: Generated git_push.sh Token/Staging Risk
nodes.rationale: Generated publishing script could stage unrelated caller files and embedded a credential token in the Git remote URL.

nodes.label: Global OpenAPI CSRF-on-Reads Defect
nodes.rationale: Global security required CSRF for read-only operations; elevated to Major to use session auth as the read-safe default and declare CSRF only on mutating operations.

nodes.label: Overlapping Preference Load/Update Race
nodes.rationale: Startup, notes-shell init, and account settings could issue overlapping preference GETs while theme controls issued PUTs; an older response could overwrite a newer saved theme/language locally.

nodes.label: Share-Warning Modal Focus Defect
nodes.rationale: Custom aria-modal warning did not move or trap focus and did not restore the email-share trigger, leaving keyboard focus in the editor behind the warning.

nodes.label: Hard-coded Share-Warning/Settings Strings
nodes.rationale: Share-warning heading/reasons and notes settings-overlay text remained hard-coded English despite M10 advertising English/German UI selection.

nodes.label: Job Lock run_id Fencing Finding
nodes.rationale: A stale run could release a newer same-instance lock and work could outlive its 30-minute lease; resolved with a persisted run_id fence on acquisition/renewal/release plus 10-minute renewal.

nodes.label: Audit CSV Formula Injection Finding
nodes.rationale: Audit CSV export permitted spreadsheet formulas; resolved by neutralizing =, +, -, and @ before CSV escaping.

nodes.label: pg_dump Indefinite Wait Finding
nodes.rationale: pg_dump could wait indefinitely; resolved with a bounded 30-minute wait, termination, output disposal, and interruption handling.

nodes.label: Duplicate Bootstrap Token Delivery Finding
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap token was modeled as both a security scheme and an explicit header, letting the generated client overwrite the explicit value from configured credentials; recommended keeping one delivery mechanism.

nodes.label: Generic 4xx Problem Mapper Defect
nodes.rationale: Generic non-404 WebApplicationException responses received INTERNAL_ERROR and misleading resource text; unhandled exceptions were not logged with LOG.errorf, losing the stack trace.

nodes.label: Missing Negative failure_count Migration Test
nodes.rationale: V2__bootstrap_rate_limits.sql already rejected negative counts but lacked a behavioral migration test proving it.

nodes.label: Angular Initial Navigation Race Finding
nodes.rationale: Route guards could run before AuthStore.restore(), redirecting a valid authenticated deep link to login before replacing it with the default route; session restoration needed coordination with initial navigation.

nodes.label: CookieManager URI Parsing Defect
nodes.rationale: A malformed public URL threw IllegalArgumentException instead of a clearer configuration failure used for unsupported schemes.

nodes.label: Admin Settings Save-Before-Load Overwrite Finding
nodes.rationale: A failed initial read left editable defaults active; saving could overwrite persisted settings with values the administrator never actually loaded. Saving needed to be blocked until a successful read.

nodes.label: Reset/Invitation Bearer Token Cleartext Finding
nodes.rationale: Manually entered reset and invitation bearer tokens were displayed as plain text in input fields.
